title: Persona Profile Timeline — payload
description: What one face has done, in order: composed, worn and taken off, what it told whom, when a value it shows changed, retired and reinstated. Types, versions, contexts and parties — never a value, never one of the holder's private labels.

contextId.description: The context of a context-local face. Omit for a pool face.

since.description: Only events at or after this time.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a prior response. A producer MUST NOT construct or parse one.

TimelineEvent.title: TimelineEvent
TimelineEvent.description: One thing that happened to a face. Which members are present depends on `kind`; none carries a value or a private label.

kind.description: `composed` — the face was made. `worn` / `unworn` — a persona began or stopped wearing it in a context. `expired` — a binding's `until` passed. `disclosed` — it told a party something (`verifierDid`, `claimTypes`). `valueChanged` — a value it shows changed (`claimTypes`, `version`). `promoted` — it moved from one context into the pool. `retired` / `reinstated`.

Response.title: Persona Profile Timeline — response payload
Response.description: Success response to persona/profile/timeline. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/persona/profile/timeline/1.0#response. Oldest first.

nextCursor.description: Present when more events follow. Absent at the end — a producer MUST NOT infer the end from a short page.
